A thin plate is installed in a water tunnel as splitter. The plate is 0.4 m long and 1.2 m wide.   
The freestrearn speed is 1.8 m/s. Assume laminar boundary layers form on both sides of the   
plate and the velocity profile approximated as parabolic. Determine the total <sub>drag</sub> on the   
plate. Take $\rho = 9 9 8 ~ \mathrm { k g / m ^ { 3 } }$ and $\mu = 1 . 2 \times 1 0 ^ { - 3 }$ Pa.s.
